seo.title: Couples Christmas Sweatshirts – We Said No Gifts. We Lied.
seo.description: Couples Christmas sweatshirts: a 1960s couple hiding presents behind their backs under WE SAID NO GIFTS. We lied. Unisex crewneck, S–3XL.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

We said no gifts. We lied: couples Christmas sweatshirts for the pair who broke the deal again, worn to the family party.

The art is a 1960s husband and wife standing back to back in front of a decorated tree, each hiding a wrapped present behind their back, his mustard with a red ribbon and hers cream with a sage ribbon. WE SAID NO GIFTS. runs across the top in heavy red capitals and We lied. below in a big black script; on Navy both turn cream and the pair gets a cream outline.

Each crewneck is sold singly, so a pair means two in the cart: add one for each of you and wear them to the family party, the cookie swap or the Christmas Eve gift exchange. Printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex crewneck sweatshirt fit
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Ribbed crew neck, cuffs and waistband; no hood, no pockets
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 5 colors: White, Sand, Sport Grey, Ash, Navy

Questions

How does the We Said No Gifts crewneck fit?
This classic unisex Gildan 18000 crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. comes in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomy, cozy look over a long-sleeve tee. If the size is off, we offer one free size exchange within 30 days of delivery.

How warm is it and what is it made of?
The We Said No Gifts crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. is 50% cotton and 50% polyester fleece at 8 oz per square yard, with a ribbed collar, cuffs and waistband and no hood. It is a mid-weight, cozy layer for a family party or a cold walk to the tree. Machine wash cold inside out and tumble dry low.

How do I order a matching pair for a couple?
Each crewneck is sold on its own, so add two to the cart, one in each size, in the same color or two different ones. Graphic Tees Co. prints each sweatshirt to order, and orders of $45 or more ship free, so a pair always qualifies. The free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess.

What colors does it come in and how is it printed?
It comes in White, Sand, Sport Grey, Ash and Navy, all in sizes S through 3XL. On the four light colors the headline is red and the script black; on Navy both turn cream, with a cream outline around the couple so every word and line stays clear. Graphic Tees Co. prints each one to order.

When should I order for Christmas?
Order by about December 8 so the We Said No Gifts crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. arrives before Christmas. Each sweatshirt is printed to order, which takes a few business days, then ships within the US. Orders of $45 or more ship free, and a misprint or damaged item is reprinted or refunded within 30 days.
